description: Execute a payment to an ACTIVE agent session's pinned recipient, within its on-chain spending policy — no per-payment user approval. The recipient and amount must satisfy the session's allowlist and per-execution / per-period caps, and the child Safe must hold enough balance. For safe retries pass a stable idempotencyKey: retrying with the SAME key returns the original transaction instead of double-spending. WITHOUT an idempotencyKey, retries are only de-duplicated within a ~30s window — a delayed retry (e.g. after a bundler/network timeout) could send a second payment. Call get_agent_session first to confirm the session is ACTIVE and check remainingPeriodCap.

amount.description: Amount to send, in user-facing units (e.g. '10.00'). Must satisfy the per-execution and remaining per-period caps.

currency.description: Stablecoin denomination — must match the session token.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional stable key for safe retries. Reuse the SAME key when retrying a payment you're unsure completed (e.g. after a timeout) — the original transaction is returned rather than sending twice. Use a FRESH key for each new payment. If omitted, retries are only de-duplicated within a ~30s window.

recipient.description: The crypto recipient address (0x…). Must match the session's pinned recipient.

sessionId.description: The agent session id returned by create_agent_session.

name: agent_execute_payment
